3) Only notifications from the same Android app package as in your Play link are captured — if nothing shows up, check the toggle and that the link matches the app you installed.

settings.privacyPolicyBody:
Last updated: May 2026.

Centifi processes the information you provide when you create an account, the expenses and categories you save, and the preferences you choose to store on our servers. We use this data only to operate the app and improve your experience.

We protect data in transit using encryption where supported. You can sign out at any time; budget and category data synced to your account remains associated with it until you delete your account or request erasure where applicable.

If you have questions about this policy, email info@centifi.app.

By using Centifi, you acknowledge this privacy policy.
